paragraphs.text: In October 2024, Geo BioPharm LLC conducted veterinary research and development involving an investigational Biological Hemoglobin Oxygen Carrier (BHOC). One case involved a 0.5 kg kitten presenting in critical condition.
On October 19, the kitten was unable to move, had unstable breathing, and was not passing stool. An initial infusion of 15 mL of the investigational oxygen carrier was administered at 10 mL/h.
By the following morning, the kitten was active and responsive. A second infusion of 10 mL was administered 22 hours after the first. Further clinical improvement was reported during follow-up.

By October 23, the kitten was passing stool normally, its gums appeared pinker, and repeat blood tests showed improvement in several hematological parameters. Anemia associated with suspected intoxication was considered, although the underlying diagnosis was not confirmed in the available case account.
The accompanying photographs and laboratory reports document the kitten’s condition and changes observed over this period. The administration details describe this individual historical case.
Within Precision Oxygen Therapeutics, these observations provide a basis for further structured investigation of veterinary oxygen carriers and clinically meaningful follow-up outcomes.
